decisions.statement: The points are read from the tracking the workstation's checkout carries.
Every attribute the tracking day has as a key is read in one ask.
The stretches the charisma counts are filed under that day's id.
The charisma is read after the day rather than beside the day.
The constitution counts food entries rather than reading a figure off the day.
The luck counts rejections rather than reading a figure off the day.
A rejection that came back as a no counts twice over one Alan only risked.
One watch takes every attribute reading.
One timer carries every attribute reading to the site that draws the attributes.
A source that cannot be read stops its own readings rather than another source's.
A carry that fails to one tile does not stop the carry to another tile.
A relay with many readings is given longer to run than a relay with a single reading.
The tile shows the points Alan's workstation last took.
An attribute nothing can be read for is shown as no signal rather than as a zero.
`akasha measure attribute` answers an attribute's level beside that attribute's total.
An attribute no readout counts is left out of the answer.
A total is floored to two decimal places.
Points are counted forward from the day an attribute begins.
No day before the day an attribute begins is backfilled.

definition: the points Alan's daily upkeep habits earned him on a day
